records.title: GitChameleon 2.0: Evaluating AI Code Generation Against Python Library Version Incompatibilities
records.reason: The abstract presents a benchmark for version-conditioned code generation and tests LLM/agent/RAG correctness; it evaluates application quality rather than inference-system efficiency.

records.title: Influence Guided Context Selection for Effective Retrieval-Augmented Generation
records.reason: The method values and filters retrieved contexts at inference time and predicts context influence to reduce poor context processing; this is a direct RAG inference context-selection mechanism.

records.title: Gated Memory: Admission-Controlled Memory Formation for Conversational AI
records.reason: The paper improves conversational memory formation and downstream answer quality, but the abstract does not report reduced latency, memory footprint, or compute use.

records.title: Selene: Cross-Level Barrier-Free Pipelining for Irregular Nested Loops in High-Level Synthesis
records.reason: Selene introduces a barrier-free pipeline architecture and cross-level scheduling compiler for irregular-loop HLS, reporting higher hardware pipeline throughput; this is a compiler/hardware acceleration contribution.

records.title: Transformer with Memory Replay
records.reason: Transformer with Memory Replay reports reduced wall-clock overhead and runtime efficiency, but its stated goal is sample-efficient pretraining and the abstract does not establish a target inference-system efficiency gain.

records.title: Analyzing Memory Effects in Large Language Models through the lens of Cognitive Psychology
records.reason: The abstract studies cognitive-psychology memory effects in LLM behavior; this is model behavior analysis rather than system efficiency.

records.title: PipelineRL: Faster On-policy Reinforcement Learning for Long Sequence Generation
records.reason: PipelineRL overlaps asynchronous LLM generation and RL training to increase accelerator utilization and speed up learning; this is training throughput, not inference serving efficiency.

records.title: Screening of multi deep learning-based de novo molecular generation models and their application for specific target molecular generation
records.reason: The abstract evaluates deep-learning molecular-generation models for EGFR drug discovery; this is a domain application, not inference-system efficiency.

records.title: Learning to Schedule Multi-Server Jobs With Fluctuated Processing Speeds
records.reason: The abstract proposes an online multi-server scheduler that learns fluctuating service rates and optimizes system utility under operating/energy costs; this is compute-service scheduling infrastructure.

records.title: Contextual Chart Generation for Cyber Deception
records.reason: The paper generates synthetic charts for cybersecurity honeyfiles using Transformer/autoencoder models; the contribution is a security application, not inference efficiency.

records.title: DeepNote: Note-Centric Deep Retrieval-Augmented Generation
records.reason: DeepNote improves adaptive retrieval and answer quality for RAG; the abstract does not identify lower inference latency, memory, or compute usage.

records.title: QuantU-Net: Efficient Wearable Medical Imaging Using Bitwidth as a Trainable Parameter
records.reason: QuantU-Net uses trainable bitwidth/quantization to reduce model size for low-power FPGA deployment and real-time wearable inference; this is an explicit edge-compute efficiency technique.

records.title: MIRAGE: A Metric-Intensive Benchmark for Retrieval-Augmented Generation Evaluation
records.reason: MIRAGE contributes a dataset and metrics for RAG evaluation; benchmarking quality is not itself an inference-system efficiency contribution.

records.title: SEED: A Structural Encoder for Embedding-Driven Decoding in Time Series Prediction with LLMs
records.reason: SEED uses an encoder and frozen LLM for time-series forecasting; the abstract emphasizes prediction performance and modularity, not reduced system cost.

records.title: PyBangla at BLP-2025 Task 2: Enhancing Bangla-to-Python Code Generation with Iterative Self-Correction and Multilingual Agents
records.reason: The paper evaluates Bangla-to-Python code generation with iterative self-correction and multilingual agents; it is an application benchmark, not inference systems optimization.

records.title: Edge-Efficient Two-Stream Multimodal Architecture for Non-Intrusive Bathroom Fall Detection
records.reason: The paper's two-stream fall-detection architecture explicitly lowers latency and energy per inference on a Raspberry Pi edge gateway; this is direct edge-inference efficiency.

records.title: Conduit: An Experience Data Plane for Distributed Reinforcement Learning
records.reason: Conduit exposes RL experience handling as a runtime, uses CPU/GPU memory tiers and latency-aware scheduling, and reports lower exposed and iteration latency at scale; this is systems efficiency.

records.title: From Features to Transformers: Redefining Ranking for Scalable Impact
records.reason: The arXiv abstract describes single-pass history processing and set-wise attention for efficient serving of a large ranking model, directly relevant to inference serving. The arXiv record is marked withdrawn; this status is noted.

records.title: Cite Before You Speak: Enhancing Context-Response Grounding in E-commerce Conversational LLM-Agents
records.reason: The abstract improves factual grounding and citation experience for an e-commerce conversational agent; scalable inference is mentioned as a deployment property, but no system-efficiency method or gain is established.

records.title: Efficient Speech Language Modeling via Energy Distance in Continuous Latent Space
records.reason: SLED simplifies speech-language-model architecture and states that it maintains inference efficiency, but the abstract focuses on synthesis quality in a speech-specific application; the system-efficiency link remains limited.
